address: 27 rue de la Préfecture, Nice, 06300, France
bio: The lilting accent of the South of France can be detected in this bistro, where a really convivial atmosphere reigns. Things hot up in the kitchen, with delicious dishes such as old-fashioned pork casserole with creamy polenta, knife-cut beef tartare or grilled veal kidney with wholegrain mustard and baby potatoes in a parsley sauce... Crowded? Well, yes: Antoine has a huge (and well-deserved) success on his hands....
